_readme: The other giraffes. Walk up to one and a prompt appears; press E (or tap the
TALK button) to hear them. Each press moves to their next line and then loops.
Everything here is safe to rewrite — these are just placeholder personalities.
`at` is where they stand: [x, y, z]. `outfit` is a list from OUTFITS in
js/giraffe.js: topHat, partyHat, beanie, sunHat, flowerCrown, glasses, shades,
scarf, bowTie, sweater, cape, backpack. `loop` is how wide a circle they
During the fly-around at the end they scatter instead of talking.

people.name: Juniper
lines: Oh! You must be Sarah. We’ve been hoping you’d come.
Todd built all of this, you know. Every hill of it.
He kept moving that little house around until it looked right. Took him ages.
Go on — follow the light. It knows where it’s going.

people.name: Marlow
lines: Morning! Lovely day for it. Every day’s a lovely day here, mind.
Don’t tell Juniper I said so, but she’s been practising that greeting all week.
There are sixteen lanterns out there. Sixteen! He counted them out on his hooves.
If you fall, you just turn up again somewhere safe. Nothing here can really hurt you.

people.name: Pip
lines: I’ve had this hat on for three days in case you turned up. Worth it.
Bertrand said you wouldn’t come. Bertrand says a lot of things.
Is it true you two used to fight over the front seat? Marlow heard that somewhere.
Take your time! Nobody here is in a hurry. We live in a meadow.

people.name: Clementine
lines: Careful in the trees, it gets a bit dim. Beautiful though.
He wrote all those notes himself. Sat there for hours getting them right.
I do hope she likes it, he kept saying. I do hope she likes it.
You do, don’t you? Like it? I’ll tell him you smiled.

people.name: Bertrand
lines: Ah. The sister. Delighted, genuinely delighted.
I maintain the high branches. Somebody has to, and it isn’t going to be Pip.
I never said you wouldn’t come. I said it was a long way. Different thing entirely.
The view from up here is the best in the world. He made it that way on purpose.

people.name: Odie
lines: Hey. Cool cactus, right? I like to think I match the cactus.
Everyone’s been so excited about you. It’s been unbearable, honestly. In a nice way.
Wait till you see the sky further up. It goes properly dark and full of stars.
Whoever you are to him, he clearly likes you a whole lot.

people.name: Winnifred
lines: You made it up here! Not everyone does. Sit a moment, the clouds are soft.
Odie tells everyone he matches the cactus. He does not match the cactus.
Nearly there now. The last one’s right at the top.
Thank you for coming. It meant an awful lot to him that you would.

people.name: Sage
lines: Almost the top. Don’t rush the last bit — he saved something for you up there.
We all watched him make this. He was so nervous about it.
You’re the reason the whole place exists, if you think about it.
Off you go. We’ll be here.
